The use of MCM in exterior wall coverings is subject to the following limitations:
   1.   MCM is prohibited in exterior wall coverings in Type IV construction utilizing cross-laminated timer (CLT) or structural composite lumber (SCL) complying with Section 602.4.
   2.   MCM is prohibited in exterior wall coverings at exterior balconies in accordance with Section 1406.3.

The use of MCM in exterior wall coverings is subject to the following limitations:

 1. MCM is prohibited in exterior wall coverings in Type IV construction utilizing cross-laminated timer (CLT) or structural composite lumber (SCL) complying with Section 602.4.

 2. MCM is prohibited in exterior wall coverings at exterior balconies in accordance with Section 1406.3.
